label: For "Float Pool & Cross-Department Staff Allocation": Allocate eligible float-pool and cross-trained staff to units with shortages, improving coverage while preserving continuity, fairness, rest periods and cost limits. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Scoring plans on forecast shortage only.
